mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and triggers expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust demand, which may lead to inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 indicates a robust supply-side expansion, which typically supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns during early-cycle expansion phases over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early-cycle expansion periods (INDPRO > 110).

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (RSAFS) consistently reflects strong economic activity and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the annualized Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which increases the probability of monetary tightening and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates an extremely tight labor market, which drives wage inflation and prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: In early-stage demand expansion (RSAFS above 380,000), strong consumer spending supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of early-stage demand expansion periods (RSAFS > 380,000).
